label: Thin reasons exclude universal credentialing given prior transfer and well-foundedness
description: Assuming the universal credential requirement along with the supplied prior transfer, well-foundedness and presentation would produce thin global reasonlessness, contradicting the existing F6 witness in that very reason relation. The negation is conditional on all these premises; the result does not establish F6, well-foundedness, or refute a weaker credential requirement with no strictly prior reason.
